campaign.title: Apply the host-authorized numeric edits for clamp.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED(X)
  CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED = X
  IF (X < -11) THEN
    CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED = -11
  END IF
  IF (X > 18) THEN
    CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED = 18
  END IF
  CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED = CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE_001_ACCEPTED(X)
  CASE_001_ACCEPTED = 0
  IF (CASE001_CLAMP_RENAMED(X) >= 9) THEN
    CASE_001_ACCEPTED = 1
  END IF
  CASE_001_ACCEPTED = CASE_001_ACCEPTED
END FUNCTION
